source_instruction: i am looking fresh scent body lotion for dry skin.
query: Oh my gosh, I just had the silliest run-in on my walk over here ten minutes ago—there was this tiny fluffy corgi wearing a tiny neon yellow rain jacket trotting down the sidewalk, and it broke free from its owner for a second to dart right over and steal half the blueberry muffin I was holding out of my hand! I stood there for a second just staring at it with crumbs on my wrist, and the owner was so apologetic they tried to Venmo me for the muffin, but I told them it was totally fine, that muffin was way too sweet anyway and that little guy looked like he was having the best day of his whole life. I even stopped to pet him for a minute, and he had the softest little ears I’ve ever felt, all fuzzy from the light drizzle that’s been falling on and off all morning. It totally made my whole day even though I lost half my snack, honestly, I’ve been grinning about it the whole time I’ve been in the store. Hey there, I’m browsing the body care section right now and need something formulated for combination skin that has that nice fresh scent, plus it absolutely has to be paraben-free. I don’t want to overpay, so can you just show me options that are a reasonable price? I’d really appreciate it if you could pull up matching picks pretty quickly since I’m running a little late to meet my friend after this.

extras.text: options that are a reasonable price
